summary: Guard Dog M1 iteration 2 hardening verified end-to-end against the live public URL. Backend: new /app/backend/tests/test_m1_signing_hardening.py (11 tests, all pass) plus the pre-existing suite (93 tests) => 104/104 pytest pass. Verified: POST /api/rules/sign returns 401 without token and with wrong token; 409 CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED when confirm missing or false; 403 RULESET_NOT_ALLOWED for rulesetId='gd-other-ruleset'; 422 CONTROLLED_CONFIG_MISMATCH both when the controlled block for m1-block-test.guarddog.example is replaced by an unrelated 'evil.example' block AND when the controlled host is flipped to allow; happy path with token+confirm+[controlled block, {ruleId:'t-<random>', host:'Evil.Example.', action:'block'}] returns 200 with bundleVersion prev+1, canonicalizes 'Evil.Example.' -> 'evil.example', preserves the m1-block-test.guarddog.example block, and GET /api/rules/gd-m1-controlled-block/latest still contains the controlled block afterwards. Public surfaces (/api/keys, /api/config, /api/health, /api/rules/gd-m1-controlled-block/latest) contain neither the Ed25519 private seed 'qPjRUS79sQkfUvlyMdlu38nbDtuau+N3JSYEgLh2gWw=' (nor the secondary seed) nor the admin token 'm1-dev-admin-token-change-me'. /api/config exposes controlledEndpoint.isPlaceholder=true and signing={enabled:true, requiresAdminToken:true, requiresConfirm:true, allowedRulesets:['gd-m1-controlled-block']}. Supervisor backend logs at /var/log/supervisor/backend.*.log do not contain the private seed. Frontend (viewport 390x844, EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL): harness-screen loads clean (no red screen), config-ruleset='gd-m1-controlled-block', bundle-version='v14 · 2 rule(s)'; run-proof-button produces the honest step sequence (config PASS, bundle PASS, verify BLOCKED, before BLOCKED, consent BLOCKED, start SKIPPED) with harness-verdict 'Proof incomplete: requires Android native build + real controlled endpoint.' and no event-THREAT_BLOCKED node. New Proof report export card: build-report-button enabled after the run; clicking it renders report-proof-complete='no — milestone open', report-evidence-id='none', report-json containing auditChain.canonicalControlledHost='m1-block-test.guarddog.example', signedBundle.rulesetId='gd-m1-controlled-block', keyId='gd-m1-test-ed25519-001', payloadHash present, configuredControlledIpv4='203.0.113.10', routeActivation.status='SKIPPED'. export-pdf-button exists (not clicked on web to avoid opening the OS print dialog). Regression: default analyze-url-button yields analysis-sanitized-url='https://m1-block-test.guarddog.example/login' and analysis-verdict='block (m1-controlled-block-001)'. No deprecated Expo packages detected in the harness/proofReport wiring; expo-print is the current recommended package for PDF export. Mocked provider (Google Web Risk unconfigured) remains correctly reported via provider.configured=false.
critical_code_review_comments: signing_guard.enforce_signing_preconditions is called from the route, but enforce_controlled_configuration is not invoked in rules.py — verify it is executed inside rule_service.sign_and_publish (all live tests exercising CONTROLLED_CONFIG_MISMATCH pass, so wiring is correct in practice; the split just makes the guard chain less discoverable from the route file).

buildProofReport signature is (config, bundle, result, events); index.tsx passes bundle.data ?? null which is fine, but the ProofReport.auditChain.packetObservation type is Record<string, number> | null while GuardDogSecuritySDK.getEnforcementStats() may return richer keys — consider tightening the type to what is actually emitted.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all spec assertions verified on live URL)

seed_data_creation: Happy-path sign test signs a new bundle for gd-m1-controlled-block that includes the CONTROLLED_RULE plus a canonicalization probe 'Evil.Example.'->'evil.example'; because the controlled block is preserved, /api/rules/gd-m1-controlled-block/latest continues to yield verdict=block for m1-block-test.guarddog.example and the frontend regression passes. bundleVersion is now v14.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://guard-dog-m1.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin header: X-GuardDog-Admin-Token: m1-dev-admin-token-change-me. Signing guard chain (all enforced): (1) require_admin (401), (2) settings.signing_enabled (403 SIGNING_DISABLED), (3) confirm:true (409 CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED), (4) rulesetId in settings.signing_allowed_rulesets (403 RULESET_NOT_ALLOWED), (5) for gd-m1-controlled-block the canonical rules must contain exactly one block for m1-block-test.guarddog.example and zero allow for it (422 CONTROLLED_CONFIG_MISMATCH). Any signing call MUST include the controlled block rule; both integration files handle this. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_m1_signing_hardening.py -v (fast, ~1.5s). Frontend proof-report card testIDs: build-report-button, export-pdf-button, report-proof-complete, report-evidence-id, report-json, report-pdf-uri (only after Export PDF). Do NOT click export-pdf-button in headless web tests — it triggers Print.printAsync which opens the browser print dialog and can block the run.
rca_of_issue: No product defects detected this iteration. All signing hardening layers behave as specified; no private key material appears in public responses or in supervisor backend logs; the new Proof report export card builds a JSON evidence object strictly from observed harness results and correctly labels the milestone as open on web (proofComplete=false, enforcementEvidenceId=none).
